findings.correction: Does he take me for an idiot?
findings.current: Who does he think he’s talking to?
findings.defect: Softens and recasts a direct 병신 insult as a generic “who are you talking to” complaint, losing both the idiot/moron meaning and the profanity.
findings.rationale: 병신 names the addressee a fool; the line is Taekyung’s offended reaction to being walked through Friday→Saturday, not a question about who is being addressed.

findings.correction: Team Leader Choi looked at me with that peculiar expression of his as I smacked my lips.
findings.current: Team Leader Choi looked at me with that peculiar expression of his as I clicked my tongue.
findings.defect: Wrong physical action: 입맛을 다시다 is smacking/licking the lips over a missed treat, not clicking the tongue.
findings.rationale: He has just learned weekend raids are off and is tasting the lost overtime; 혀를 차다 would be a tongue-click of disapproval, which the source does not use.
findings.source: 입맛을 다시는 나를 최 팀장이 특유의 묘한 눈빛으로 바라본다.

findings.correction: I burst into tongues before I knew it.
findings.current: A dialect burst out of me before I knew it.
findings.defect: 방언 here is an involuntary torrent of speech (glossolalia/rant), not a regional dialect; the English fact is wrong.
findings.rationale: The line follows a frantic Shin Saimdang recitation and earlier church-deacon comedy; “dialect” names a language variety the source is not claiming.

findings.correction: I wore a limited-edition piece today. / The man standing behind me with his arms folded so blood wouldn’t splatter on his limited-edition Equipment
findings.current: I wore a limited-edition outfit today. / The man standing behind me with his arms folded so blood wouldn’t splatter on his limited-edition outfit
findings.defect: Second beat is explicitly 장비 (ledger: Equipment); both lines are localized as clothing “outfit.”
findings.rationale: Binding Equipment should be kept on the 장비 reprise; “outfit” makes the later hide/blood gag read as fashion rather than gear.
findings.source: 제가 오늘 한정판을 입고 와서. / 한정판 장비에 피 튈까 봐 뒤에서 팔짱만 끼고 있는 인간

findings.correction: Boss Monster, **Lv. 52 Lizardman Great Chieftain**, has appeared!
findings.current: Boss Monster, **Lv. 52 Lizardman Chieftain**, has appeared!
findings.defect: System name 대족장 is reduced to Chieftain, dropping the 대 that distinguishes it from later 족장.
findings.rationale: The panel title is 대족장; prose later uses 족장 for the same boss, so the System line should keep the fuller name.

findings.correction: The Level 40 figure and the words written at the very bottom of the Status Window were shining brightly.
findings.current: The number 40 and the words glowing at the very bottom of the Status Window were shining brightly.
findings.defect: Omits that the shining figure is Level 40, not a bare 40.
findings.rationale: 40레벨이라는 숫자 specifies a level readout; dropping Level also trips the chapter’s Level terminology check.
findings.source: 상태창에는 40레벨이라는 숫자와 맨 밑에 적힌 글씨가 반짝반짝 빛나고 있었다.

findings.correction: Burning Friday. *Bulgeum*, for short.[^n] (footnote: Korean slang for Friday night, from “burning Friday.”)
findings.defect: Unlisted Korean slang is romanized in the reading copy with no footnote.
findings.rationale: Rules require a brief footnote on first use of an unlisted culturally specific word that is kept in romanization.

summary: Several semantic and register defects: a profanity/insult is sanitized, 입맛 다시다 is rendered as the wrong gesture, and 방언 is mistranslated as “dialect.” Glossary Equipment is twice called an outfit, and the boss’s 대족장 title is flattened.
